text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way home from going out 
with Smart Falcon...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Aaah!? I totally forgot--!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I totally forgot exams are coming up 
soon...! If I don't do something, I'm 
definitely gonna fail...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I gotta hurry home and have someone teach 
me~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, even though we had a special outing 
planned... I'm so sorry, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, upon returning to the academy, 
Smart Falcon was talking with Eishin Flash 
in the central plaza.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Flash, are you heading to a race 
right now!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was just about to leave. I 
apologize for not being able to help.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm the one who should apologize for 
holding you back, Falco. Don't worry about 
this, just give the race your all!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Good luck with your test 
studying too, Falcon-san.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh…… If only I had done what Flash-san 
told me back then, it wouldn't have come 
to this……."
choice_data_list: Can't find anyone to teach you?
Can't find anyone to teach you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer...! Actually, that's right...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Nobody else is available either... The 
future is totally pitch black! Waaah!
choice_data_list: Want me to teach you, if you'd like?
Would you like me to teach you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh, really!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much~♪ That's my Trainer! The 
most reliable person in the whole wide 
world☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Basically, studying the test scope should 
be enough. Or at least, that was the 
idea...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... It's all complete gibberish to 
meee...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it's just that I don't understand 
anything at all... Hauu~..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just looking at the textbook makes my head 
spin...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Waaah, but there's no time left~!
choice_data_list: Let's stay calm and solidify the basics!
We'll have to go with our gut!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... If that's what you say, Trainer, 
then Falco will believe in you and give it 
a shot!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was quite tough, but we went all the 
way back to the past and thoroughly 
reviewed the fundamentals."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I did it, Trainer☆ My score was way better 
than usual♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's because the way you taught me was so 
gentle and easy to understand, Trainer! 
Thank you♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I know☆ To show my gratitude, I'll start a 
special live show just for you, Trainer, 
right now☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna sing my new song! "Fast & 
Courteous ☆ Studious & Perfect ♪ 
Trainer-san"!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san is~ also a teacher~♪ And a 
wonderfully capable one at that~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps exhausted from studying, Smart 
Falcon's energy has gotten really weird...
choice_data_list: Come on, let's take a break!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!? But the curtain call is supposed to 
completely capture everyone's hearts!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I somehow managed to persuade Smart 
Falcon, telling her to go home and get 
some rest...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! In that case, there'll be less 
stuff we need to study, right!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right, Falco's gonna make a full-power 
gamble on this☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaan! Falco managed to make a 
narrow getaway☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Managing to dodge getting failing marks 
was all thanks to you, Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yup☆ Thank you so much♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I know! My next new song will be 'Tests & 
Wild Guesses'! I'll write the music and 
lyrics just for you, Trainerâª

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"For the choreography, the 'Yama' part is 
like... standing on top of a mountain 
shouting 'Yahoo!'..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
How about holding up an index finger for 
“intuition,” like getting a “flash of 
inspiration☆”?
choice_data_list:
More importantly, make sure to study 
regularly.

More importantly, let's make sure to study 
regularly.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I-I know that already~. It's just 
so hard to do~...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Trainer-san, you sound just like 
Flash-san, honestly~
